whatWasWrong.clippingAndOverlapAndProtectedFields: One cause, two obligations. Every check box on CR-307 and CR-308 carries /AS /Off with an /AP /N dictionary holding an /On entry and NO /Off entry, and /MK << /CA (8) >> with no /BC. pdf-lib's PDFCheckBox.needsAppearancesUpdate() is true on exactly that condition, so form.updateFieldAppearances() invented an appearance from its default provider - a stroked square the size of the widget /Rect - and flatten() stamped it onto the page. Under ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 a conforming viewer paints nothing at such a widget, so the square was ink this build added and not ink the Maine Judicial Branch authored, landing as a doubled ring around the box the form already prints. Three of the nine sat on CR-308's GRANTED / GRANTED / DENIED ordering boxes, which the build's own reports/blanks.json refuses as `an ordering box on the order the judge signs` and participant-instructions.md tells the participant belong to the judge - so the same synthesis was the PROTECTED_FIELDS failure as well.
whatWasWrong.whyNoCounterSawIt: It draws no glyph, so nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes read 0 honestly while the page was wrong, and it grows the ink extent about 0.6pt, so a bounding-box test could not see it either. The shared completeness verifier returned all nine zeros on the defective bytes.
whatWasWrong.selfHelpStop: The most sensitive route in the sprint carried almost none of the boundary its own record states. None of the track record's seven selfHelpStopConditions reached participant copy verbatim and only one reached it in substance. Neither scopeRestriction appeared. The State Bureau of Identification dissemination instruction did not appear. No durability statement appeared at all - while CR-308 page 2 prints the extinguishment warning verbatim in the delivered packet, so a survivor read the form's warning as the law. And filing-instructions.md affirmatively pointed the participant at the consent route (`CR-308's first ordering box is the no-hearing route`) without saying that choosing it is on the record's own stop list.
whatWasWrong.requiredBeforeFiling: The four form blanks classed required-before-filing were disclosed properly; the record's participant-action list was not. The certified judgment and docket record, the § 2264(4-A) documentation and the professional affidavit were named nowhere, and the words certified, docket record, documentation, affidavit, presumption and courtroom were absent from participant copy.

It identifies the court and the case, it is the same caption CC-DC-089 carries on pages 1 and 2, and it is filled from the same field map entries. The 18 fields the packet refuses are all fields of the order itself - the eight findings boxes and their two description lines, the granted / granted-in-part / denied election, the amount and date ordered, the party name in the order, and the judge's signature, date and ID. So the geometry was right and the sentence was wrong, and the sentence changed in all three places at once.
whatWasDone.routeOptionsDisclosure: routeSelectionsMade is no longer a hand-kept list. It is derived from the checkbox writes themselves, carries each row's own basis as its source support, and the build now REFUSES to produce a packet in which a ticked box has no stated basis. participant-instructions.md opens with a section that lists every one of them with its basis and says nothing else on either form is marked.
whatWasDone.routeOptionsItemOne: The brief said a sworn election made from an inference is not cured by disclosing it, and that if the record does not establish which of arrested / summons / citation is true the packet must not tick it. I checked the record: legal-design-track-registry.json track md_pardon_expungement carries NINE generationRequirements - court and county, case number, charges in the incident, disposition of each, pending charges, pardon signature date, only-one-criminal-act, crime-of-violence, and whether a fee waiver is wanted. None asks how the case began, and the words arrest, summons and citation occur ZERO times in the whole track record. The platform does not collect the fact. So the tick is removed, all three boxes are carried as genuine participant elections, and the guide has a section of its own telling the participant that the packet has left the check-one empty, why, and to tick the true one before signing. The date, the agency and the place stay written because the form's own sentence puts each of those blanks after all three alternatives ('by an officer of the ___'), so they assert nothing about the mode; the one label this build gave that DID presume an arrest - 'the law enforcement agency whose officer arrested me' - was corrected to the form's own construction.
whatWasDone.theCourtBoxIsProvedRatherThanInferred: The caption's court box stays ticked, and on a different footing from item 1: the same track record DOES ask for this fact by name - generationRequirement courtAndCounty, 'Which court heard the case, and in which county or Baltimore City?', marked required - and the held answer is written into the caption's own chooser, whose option list is the form's and whose District Court options all carry the suffix '(DC)'. The build now refuses to produce a packet unless the held location actually carries that suffix, so a held location that is not a District Court location stops the build instead of silently ticking the wrong member of a select-one on a sworn petition. The published basis names the fact, the suffix and the generationRequirement.

defectOne.name: TWO FRAMES AT EVERY CHECK BOX ON PACKET PAGE 2
defectOne.howItWasFound: not by byte accounting, which called all 36 unmatched streams accounted for, but by rendering the source page THREE ways. (1) The source's own page content, with /Annots deleted, PRINTS a small box at each check position. (2) The source's /AP /N /Off appearance paints an opaque rectangle OVER that printed box and strokes a slightly larger one of its own, so a conforming viewer and a printer show ONE box. (3) The delivered page stamped the same appearance with its fill stripped, so the printed box was revealed AND the appearance's own box was stamped on top.
defectOne.measured: five check boxes on packet page 2, on both fixtures. A 150 dpi difference against the pinned source page put the added ink at exactly those five widget rectangles.
defectOne.whyTheStripIsRightWhereItWasWrittenFor: a white rectangle inside a TEXT field's appearance would erase the printed words underneath it. It is wrong only for a selection control, whose fill is the thing that makes its appearance REPLACE the printed box instead of doubling it.
defectOne.repair: preserveUnwrittenSelectionBackgrounds: true - the committed, opt-in remedy whose own note in the shared module records it from Pennsylvania 490/790, 'a white blank-state rectangle to cover a smaller printed box; stripping it reveals two frames'. It preserves only source-authored paint, only in an unwritten check box or radio widget, and only where the source ships the appearance. No mark is added and /MK /BG is still removed.
defectOne.effectMeasuredAlone: added 0 pixels, removed 368, all five clusters on packet page 2 and every one inside a check-box widget rect. Pages 1, 3, 4 and 5 pixel-identical.

defectTwo.name: THREE SELECTION CONTROLS STAMPED 32% LARGER THAN THE COURT DRAWS THEM
defectTwo.howItWasFound: the raster still showed a heavy ring where the source draws a light one after defect one was repaired. Reading the pinned form's FIELD TREE rather than its page /Annots - which is why a rect-keyed scan misses them - three widgets carry /Rect 13.68 by 13.68 with an /AP /N appearance BBox of 0 0 18 18: item 4B's 'No.' at /Rect 268.80 356.50 282.48 370.18, item 4B's 'Yes.' at 313.88 356.62 327.56 370.30, and page 2's Prosecuting Attorney box at 126.00 658.96 139.68 672.64.
defectTwo.why: ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 requires the appearance BBox to be mapped onto the widget /Rect, a scale of 0.76 here. pdf-lib's flatten applies no such mapping and stamps all three at 18pt.
defectTwo.measured: 426 and 409 added pixels at the two page-1 radios with 237 and 228 removed where the court's smaller ring was, and 222 added with 76 removed at the page-2 box. Side by side the court draws a light 13.7pt ring and the packet drew a heavy 18pt one around it.
defectTwo.repair: fitAppearancesToRect: true. It refuses a placement whose mapping is already the identity, so nothing already right is rewritten, and it changes no stream content - only the matrix the flatten places it with.
